programs.title: Gumrah
programs.desc: Meena, who lives with her retired and widowed father in rural Nainital, is visited by her sister, her husband and her two children. Meena speaks of her love for Rajendra, a painter and singer, and Kamla, her sister, approves of her choice. However, before Meena can make a move, Kamla passes away leaving her children in the hands of Meena.

programs.title: Andaz
programs.desc: Sheetal, a widow, is a school teacher and lives with her son after her husband's death. She meets her student's father Ravi, a widower, and decides to marry him.

programs.title: Desh Premee
programs.desc: Dinanath is a freedom fighter married to Bharati. During the freedom struggle, though freedom is won but, he looses Bharati - who leaves as she is affected by leprosy. He is given shelter in Bharat Nagar - as four underworld dons of Bharat Nagar.
